summary:
Cycle date calculation and auto-defaults completely corrected:
1. Fixed getMonthDefaults & getDatesForMonthName: accurately suggests the next uncreated month (December 2026), starting 1st at 12:00 AM (00:00) and ending on the 1st of next month at 2:00 PM (14:00).
2. Resolved previous bug where the form erroneously proposed 30-Nov to 30-Dec.
3. Updated November 2026 and October 2026 in PostgreSQL database and local backup: November runs from Nov 1, 12:00 AM to Dec 1, 2:00 PM; October runs from Oct 1, 12:00 AM to Nov 1, 2:00 PM.
4. Clean build and lint confirmed.
